newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian government credits 13.5 pct up in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Romanian government credits 13.5 pct up in Nov.

text.p: Credits to the Romanian government surged by 13.5 percent to 3.96 trillion lei last November, pushing overall domestic loans by 6.4 percent up from the previous month, central bank data (BNR) showed.
Loans to the government took about 14 percent of end- November domestic credits which stood at 29.0 trillion lei.
Non-government credits rose by 5.4 percent to 25.0 trillion lei in November, with hard currency loans on an upward path expanding by 5.6 percent to 8.76 trillion lei.
Short-term loans accounted for 83.7 percent of end-November leu loans, which stood at 16.3 trillion lei, up from 15.49 trillion the previous month.
State companies held 56 percent of end-November leu loans.
Inflation was 5.8 percent last November, up 47.4 percent year-on-year. ($=4,370 lei) -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
